scope: Read-only review of the PID-pinned read-only-alias delta. No live host/provider/DB/browser calls, tests, private credential reads, or code edits.

systemd_mask_respect.detail: The resolver now names only narrow `/run/alisa-native-binding/{bindings,source,credentials}` aliases. It does not remove, relax, or read through existing InaccessiblePaths masks for `/etc/alice-market` or `/run/credentials`; root_json still enforces root-owned, non-writable directory chains and no-follow bounded regular-file opens. The selected credential file must be on a read-only mount. The alias/service configuration remains a separate install-review gate.

native_generation_pin.detail: The scope projection's HMAC binds native PID, `/proc/<pid>/stat` start ticks, real UID, and boot ID. Every resolve checks this tuple against current proc metadata and requires the pinned UID equal the checker process effective UID. Any restart/PID reuse/reboot/UID change fails closed before source or candidate pair matching.

binding_semantics.detail: Generation is included in the source HMAC; current aliased native config and read-only credential are still re-read on every check. The exact Performance candidate pair must match the native credential after a strict successful token response. The result remains NATIVE_OWNER_CONFIGURED_PAIR provenance, with the same existing Seller identity equality and revision/tenant/duplicate guards.

remaining_gate: Source delta is acceptable for packaging only. Review the exact mount/alias and checker service profile before installation; never relax the existing service masks or expose additional credentials. Exact CI/package qualification and separately authorized live checks remain open.
